description: Missing access control allows unauthorized state mutation causing accounting drift

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: public state-mutation function called by unauthorized contract
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: accounting state change recorded; totalDepositsWei/balance understated
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: vault perceives shortfall and makes incorrect allocation decision as a result

high_severity_rationale: High requires proving vault makes incorrect allocation decisions leading to direct fund loss. Medium is proven by unauthorized state mutation causing accounting drift.
negative_control_template: Add onlyRegistratorOrGovernor modifier. Assert that the attacker contract call reverts. Assert totalDepositsWei unchanged.
